notes.Nikola Jokic: Cameron Johnson is doubtful with a right ankle sprain, and Denver is also without Julian Strawther, Spencer Jones and Alpha Diallo, so the forward depth is thin. Jokic has played 35, 44 and 35 minutes, and New Orleans is still missing Yves Missi in a 240.5-point game.
notes.Giannis Antetokounmpo: He posted his first Miami triple-double Monday with 29 points, 14 rebounds and 11 assists in 39 minutes, and he carries the offense with no other high-usage scorer beside him. Simone Fontecchio is doubtful, and this game has the highest total on the slate at 241.5.
notes.Donovan Mitchell: He has played 35, 35 and 38 minutes and scored 32, 22 and 26 points, and Cleveland comes in fully healthy. Washington is without Justin Champagnie and AJ Dybantsa is only questionable, but the 9.5-point spread brings some blowout risk.
notes.Jalen Johnson: He has played 36 and 38 minutes in Atlanta's competitive games, including 26 points, nine rebounds and 16 assists in 38 minutes Saturday. Aaron Wiggins is questionable with a knee contusion, and the 241.5 total is the highest on the slate.
notes.Karl-Anthony Towns: He had 27 points and 20 rebounds in 33 minutes Tuesday and has a double-double in all four games. New York is on the second night of a back-to-back and has not posted its injury report yet, and Chicago is without center Nic Claxton.
notes.Kingston Flemings: He has played 15 to 25 minutes as Atlanta's backup guard. Aaron Wiggins is questionable with a left knee contusion, and if Wiggins sits there are more guard minutes in the highest-total game on the slate.
notes.Jaylon Tyson: His minutes have slipped from 24 to 21 to 20, and Meleek Thomas joined the rotation Monday with 19 minutes. Cleveland is fully healthy, so this is a price play in a 238.5-point game, not a role bump.
Anthony Edwards is out after a right knee procedure and is expected to miss up to two months. Shannon has played 20 to 24 minutes in every game and has taken the biggest usage jump when Edwards sits.
notes.Sam Merrill: He played 31 minutes Monday, but that game went to overtime, and he played 24 and 21 minutes in the two before. Cleveland is fully healthy, so expect low-to-mid 20s.
notes.Royce O'Neale: Coby White, Kon Knueppel and Grant Williams have been out all season, so tonight's outs are not new for him. His minutes have dropped from 17 to 17 to 11 to 7, so he needs a real rotation change to pay off.
notes.Nikola Vucevic: Paolo Banchero is out with a high ankle sprain and Jalen Suggs is out with a knee bone bruise, leaving Orlando with only 10 standard-contract players. When Banchero sat Sunday, Vucevic played 15 minutes after just 5 and 4 in the first two games.
notes.Jordan Poole: He is probable with an illness. His minutes have climbed from 15 to 19 to 23 since Yves Missi got hurt, in a 240.5-point game against Denver.
notes.Trey Lyles: Anthony Edwards is out for up to two months, which opens about 33 minutes a night on the Minnesota wing. Lyles has played 12 to 17 minutes as a bench forward, so his bump is likely small.
notes.Paul Reed: He started again Tuesday with Jalen Duren out and had 22 points and nine rebounds in 26 minutes. Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks, and Detroit has not posted its injury report for Wednesday yet.
notes.Clint Capela: He is likely to start at center Wednesday with Alperen Sengun and Steven Adams out. He has averaged only about eight minutes this season, so his minutes are the big unknown.
Alperen Sengun and Steven Adams are both out, and the coach likes Smith at center in switching small-ball lineups. He played 39 minutes Monday with 16 points and 12 rebounds.
notes.Ajay Mitchell: He is questionable with a right ankle sprain after scoring a career-high 30 points in 25 minutes as a starter Monday. Oklahoma City is also without Chet Holmgren, Alex Caruso, Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace, so his role is huge if he plays.
notes.Isaiah Hartenstein: Chet Holmgren is out with right knee tendinitis. Hartenstein had double-doubles in his last two games (12 and 12, then 15 and 13) in 26 to 27 minutes, and Oklahoma City is also without Alex Caruso, Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace.
notes.Kyrie Irving: He is questionable with a knee issue and could get a maintenance day. If he sits, Marcus Sasser likely runs point and Cooper Flagg takes on more usage.
notes.Cooper Flagg: Kyrie Irving is questionable and could get a maintenance day, which would push even more usage to Flagg. He had 29 points, six rebounds and 11 assists in 40 minutes Monday.
notes.Marcus Sasser: If Kyrie Irving sits with his knee issue, Sasser is the likely point guard. He played only 8 minutes Monday after 24 to 27 in the first three games.
notes.AJ Dybantsa: He was upgraded to questionable after spraining his left ankle in the preseason finale and has not played yet. If he plays he starts, likely with limited minutes, and Bilal Coulibaly goes to the bench.
notes.Bilal Coulibaly: He has started all four games while AJ Dybantsa was out, but Dybantsa is now questionable and would take his starting spot. Coulibaly scored only three points in 29 minutes Monday.
notes.Tyrese Haliburton: He is questionable, but he has no minutes limit and has played at least 31 minutes with 18 or more points in all four games. Andrew Nembhard is also questionable and T.J. McConnell is out, so Indiana's ball-handling runs through him.
notes.Andrew Nembhard: He is questionable with back and neck soreness after resting Monday, and he is expected to return. T.J. McConnell is out, so Indiana is thin at guard.
notes.Joel Embiid: He rested Sunday to manage plantar fasciitis but is not on the injury report and is expected to play. In his last game he had 28 points, 11 rebounds and 10 assists in 36 minutes, and Indiana is without center Ivica Zubac.
notes.Victor Wembanyama: He had 29 points, 10 rebounds and five blocks in only 27 minutes in Tuesday's blowout. San Antonio is on the second night of a back-to-back and has not posted its injury report yet, and the 13.5-point spread brings blowout risk again.
notes.Julian Champagnie: He scored 26 points on 8-for-13 threes off the bench Tuesday, but that was a hot shooting night. Tobias Harris is still out, which keeps him at 25 to 30 minutes.
notes.Keyonte George: Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr., Jusuf Nurkic and possibly Lauri Markkanen, who is questionable with a wrist sprain. George has started every game and had 26 points in 33 minutes Monday.
notes.Luka Doncic: He had 41 points and nine assists in 37 minutes Tuesday, two days after scoring 52. The Lakers play the second night of a back-to-back at the Clippers and have not posted their injury report yet.
notes.Yaxel Lendeborg: He is questionable with a sore left foot and will be evaluated before tip, though the medical staff said it should be nothing serious. He had 31 points, 12 rebounds and six assists Monday, and Golden State is without Jimmy Butler, Kristaps Porzingis and Moses Moody.
notes.Jase Richardson: He made his first NBA start Sunday and played 17 minutes. Jalen Suggs and Paolo Banchero are out, and Orlando has only 10 standard-contract players available.
